cleaner.label: Other Windows items
cleaner.description: Internet Explorer history, File Explorer recent-file lists and system caches.

option.label: Internet Explorer: temporary Internet files
option.description: Empties the page cache used by Internet Explorer and by apps that use its components.

option.label: Internet Explorer: history
option.description: Deletes the history of visited sites and the New Tab page list.

option.label: Internet Explorer: cookies
option.description: Deletes the cookies of Internet Explorer and of apps that use its components.
option.warning: In apps that use these cookies you will have to sign in to the sites again. No cookie is kept.

option.label: Internet Explorer: recently typed URLs
option.description: Deletes the addresses typed in the address bar and recent searches.

option.label: Internet Explorer: last download location
option.description: Forgets the last folder used to download and save files.

option.label: Recent documents
option.description: Empties the list of recently opened files in File Explorer and the Start menu.

option.label: Run (in the Start menu)
option.description: Deletes the commands recently typed in the Run window.

option.label: Search Assistant autocomplete
option.description: Deletes the recent searches of the Search Assistant in older versions of Windows.

option.label: Other File Explorer recent lists
option.description: Deletes the recent files of the Open and Save windows, computer searches, printer ports, recently connected network drives and computer descriptions.

option.label: chkdsk file fragments
option.description: Deletes the file fragments recovered by Check Disk in the root of the system drive and in the FOUND folders.

option.label: Menu order cache
option.description: Resets the custom order of items in Windows menus.
option.warning: The order of items in menus goes back to the default.

option.label: System tray notification cache
option.description: Resets the list of notification area icons, including those of uninstalled programs.
option.warning: The choices about which icons to show in the notification area go back to the initial ones.

option.label: Window size and position cache
option.description: Resets the window sizes and positions remembered by File Explorer.
option.warning: File Explorer windows reopen with default sizes and positions.

option.label: User assist history
option.description: Resets the count of most-used programs, which Windows uses in the Start menu.
option.warning: The Start menu's most-used programs list starts over from zero.

option.label: IIS log files
option.description: Deletes the IIS web server logs in the inetpub folder.
